description: This file defines the data structures, constants, and function prototypes for a radix tree (Rax) implementation, including node structures, iterators, and API functions.

methods.name: raxNew
methods.description: Creates a new radix tree instance.

methods.name: raxInsert
methods.description: Inserts a key-value pair into the radix tree.

methods.name: raxTryInsert
methods.description: Attempts to insert a key-value pair into the radix tree.

methods.name: raxRemove
methods.description: Removes a key from the radix tree.

methods.name: raxFind
methods.description: Finds a value associated with a key.

methods.name: raxSeek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the radix tree.

methods.name: raxNext
methods.description: Moves iterator to the next element.

methods.name: raxPrev
methods.description: Moves iterator to the previous element.

methods.name: raxEOF
methods.description: Checks if the iterator has reached the end.

methods.name: raxShow
methods.description: Displays the contents of the radix tree.

methods.name: raxSize
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the radix tree.

methods.name: raxTouch
methods.description: Returns a property of a node, possibly for debugging.

methods.name: raxSetData
methods.description: Associates user data with a node.
